context_for_next_testing_agent: HR module iteration 12 adds: 1) work_experiences[] array with repeatable form in new İş təcrübəsi tab (fields: company_name, position, start_date, end_date, leave_reason), 2) marsol_company field in Contract tab with select dropdown populated from Settings/Müəssisələr, 3) reminders[] array replacing single contract_reminder checkbox - each reminder has date, time, note fields with default 'Müqavilə bitməsinə 1 ay qalmış', 4) Settings page has new Müəssisələr tab (10 tabs total) for managing marsol companies.
